bus_numbering: paper numbering 1-33; pandapower internal indexes are 0-32
selection_method: For each bus, sum in-service branch resistance along the shortest path from the slack. Sort the 32 non-slack buses by that distance and select the nearest-rank deciles of the empirical distance distribution; report paper bus numbers.
